dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: The great Iktomisaur elder's full name means "He of the Sharp Mist-Shaded Claws," while mine, "Amazolli," means "Ancient Collection of Texts."

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: So, here I am, running a bookstore.

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: Just as shamans can gain a glimpse into fate in their dreams, all things have a trail you can follow.
